title: Law to limit removal of public litter baskets
summary: This bill would stop the Department of Sanitation from removing a public litter basket just because someone used it for illegal dumping. Sanitation would have to notify the local Council member and community board before removing any basket, giving them 10 business days to comment, and would need to consider those comments before acting. The agency would also have to file quarterly public reports on baskets maintained, removed and related littering complaints, starting from the law's effective date, which is 120 days after enactment.
